_comment: Copy as slides_brief.json BEFORE building any page. One entry per slide; every task_brief must already contain the exact figures, quotes and source names taken from fact_base.json. Page architecture: references/report-design.md. Then run scripts/fact_base_audit.py against the finished pages.

design.title: Report title (e.g. 'Anatomy of a Historic Selloff')
design.reference: Classic institutional IC-memo aesthetic: deep navy canvas, ivory serif body, gold accents, mono numerals, hairline borders, generous data density (style inspiration only; no affiliation with any firm)

slides.title: Cover
slides.task_brief: Kicker 'INSTITUTIONAL RESEARCH BRIEFING · ROOT-CAUSE ANALYSIS · FOR DISCUSSION'; display title; serif-italic subtitle naming company + event; gold hairline; 4-card stat strip (headline move / mkt-cap delta / headline miss / the beat the market ignored); footer with prepared date, data cutoff, 'Sources on final slide', 'Not investment advice'; verification-status line stating which Phase 10 gates the finished deck passed (update after the final audit run): 'Verification status: full fact-base + render audits passed' or 'Draft — human verification required' + reason.

slides.title: The Verdict
slides.task_brief: Verdict-first executive summary: card 1 PRIMARY — STRUCTURAL (narrative driver + its 2-3 numbers), card 2 PRIMARY — MECHANICAL (mechanism + its numbers), card 3 AMPLIFIER (positioning/macro); full-width card-gold band 'What the panic missed' (the one-off / counter-evidence); Verified chip; source line.

slides.title: Event Timeline
slides.task_brief: Date-chip rows from priming event(s) -> print -> after-hours -> T+1 close -> same-night peers -> follow-through; each row ends with a source chip; highlight the print row (gold) and the reaction row (red).

slides.title: The Scorecard
slides.task_brief: METRIC | ACTUAL | CONSENSUS | VS EST | Y/Y table in mono numerals, red miss / green beat cells; two footnote cards: 'The optical miss' (GAAP vs adjusted bridge) and 'The real damage' (cash-flow/capex read); confidence line.

slides.title: The Move
slides.task_brief: 2x2 stat cards (T+1 close %, mkt-cap delta, distance from ATH, after-hours) + CSS .bar-track/.bar-fill drawdown ladder (ATH -> pre-print close -> post-print close -> after-hours) + setup paragraph on entry positioning; source line noting any derived values.

slides.title: Section — The Hypothesis Tree
slides.task_brief: Chapter number; title 'The Hypothesis Tree'; tagline stating N candidates tested, classification scheme, and that every claim carries a confidence tag; bottom method note (hypothesis-enumeration RCA).

slides.title: H1 — Primary narrative driver
slides.task_brief: Kicker 'HYPOTHESIS 1 · PRIMARY — THE NARRATIVE DRIVER'; card-neg 'Evidence FOR' (4-5 sourced bullets incl. one verbatim named quote) vs card-pos 'Evidence AGAINST' (company defense + counter-metrics); gold VERDICT band with confidence.

slides.title: H2 — Primary mechanical driver
slides.task_brief: Kicker 'HYPOTHESIS 2 · PRIMARY — THE MECHANICAL DRIVER'; wide card-neg 'Evidence FOR' (capex/FCF numbers) + card-gold 'The nuance' panel with dotted-leader arithmetic stack (headline -> minus one-off -> organic); gold VERDICT band.

slides.title: H3 + H4 — Contributors
slides.task_brief: Two panels side by side, each: tag chip, title, 3-4 bullets, verification chip; bottom band: 'Neither alone moves a stock this far — force multipliers for H1 + H2'.

slides.title: H5 — Positioning & Macro Amplifier
slides.task_brief: Three zone cards: Crowded setup (run-up, ATH, weight) / Macro tape (rates, inflation, Fed) / Sector tape (priming peer print, same-night rotation, follow-ons); AMPLIFIER verdict band with direction/magnitude confidence split.

slides.title: Evidence Matrix
slides.task_brief: # | HYPOTHESIS | KEY EVIDENCE | CLASSIFICATION | CONFIDENCE rows for all hypotheses; gold left border on PRIMARY rows, muted/green EXCLUDED row with falsifying fact; bottom card-gold one-sentence root cause.

slides.title: What the Market Refused to Pay For
slides.task_brief: 4 cards of verified counter-evidence datapoints (the beats, the growth engines, the backlog) + takeaway band: 'not a demand verdict on X — a verdict on the P&L path to monetizing it'; Verified chip.

slides.title: Street Reaction & Valuation Damage
slides.task_brief: SHOP | ACTION | DETAIL table (downgrades, PT before->after, consensus PT with analyst count, rating board) + 1-2 verbatim quote cards with attribution; read-through band comparing consensus PT change vs stock move (labeled Reasoned).

slides.title: Scenarios & Falsifiers
slides.task_brief: BULL (card-pos) / BASE (card) / BEAR (card-neg): each = narrative + quantifiable conditions + 'Watch:' signposts; bottom mono watchlist chips with dates; note line: 'Scenarios are analytic frames, not price targets. Confidence: Reasoned.'

slides.title: Sources & Confidence Ledger
slides.task_brief: Left: every named source as rows (mono name, serif description of exactly what it verified); right-top: confidence legend (VERIFIED/REASONED/ASSUMED chips + volatility/cutoff note); right-bottom: method + disclaimer card (informational only, not investment advice).
